name: Infusion Pump Flow to Catheter Delivery Identity
description: Syringe pump volumetric flow rate uncertainty propagates directly (identity UPR) to drug delivery rate at the catheter tip. Flow uncertainty carries unchanged through fixed tubing.

elements.name: Pump Volumetric Flow Rate
elements.description: Syringe pump set flow rate including motor and syringe uncertainty.

uncertainty.source: IEC 60601-2-24: syringe pump flow rate accuracy ±10% at set rate 5 mL/h

elements.name: Maximum Delivery Rate
elements.description: Prescribed rate ×1.10: IEC 60601-2-24 upper accuracy tolerance

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(Q_pump) = Q_pump; F=[1], f=0 — delivery rate equals pump flow with no transformation
consistency_relations.upr_description: Identity UPR: pump flow uncertainty propagates unchanged through fixed tubing to catheter delivery rate.
